name: feder-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by federbenjamin: mods that keep an agent working instead of stopping to ask, and a nightly status of your streams of work

plugins.name: dialog-timeout
plugins.description: Ends a turn left on an open dialog (permission prompt, question) for 30 min by default and tells the agent the user is /afk; /dialog-timeout <minutes>|off|on

plugins.name: cache-keepalive
plugins.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm with a short prompt 2 min before it expires; capped per model, the last one a handoff

plugins.name: stop-judge
plugins.description: Nudges the agent on when it stops early, and derives DECISIONS.md from your own sessions; /stop-judge

plugins.name: session-log
plugins.description: Keeps one markdown session log per session, pruned at compaction; ships the handoff and finish-session skills

plugins.name: session-summary
plugins.description: A band above the prompt that says what this session is about, what it is doing now, and which files to open; /session-summary

plugins.name: morning-report
plugins.description: A nightly status of your Claude Code streams, for you and your agents, plus a running catalog of what is going well and what is not; /morning-setup

plugins.name: stopstopping
plugins.description: dialog-timeout + cache-keepalive + stop-judge + session-log as one dependency-only plugin
